description: This Java class 'TemplateMergeService' provides functionality for processing templates using the Mustache templating engine. It includes methods for compiling templates with dynamic scopes, fetching external data via URLs, handling URL whitelisting, and stream processing of input data. The class also integrates with Fineract properties and security context for authentication purposes.

classes.name: TemplateMergeService
classes.description: Service class for merging templates with data, fetching external resources, and processing template outputs.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a template with a provided scope, processing mappers and expanding arrays for rendering.

methods.name: getStringFromInputStream
methods.description: Reads an InputStream into a String; utility for HTTP response processing.

methods.name: getCompiledMapFromMappers
methods.description: Processes mappers defined in the template to retrieve external data and populate the scopes map.

methods.name: getMapFromUrl
methods.description: Fetches and parses JSON or plain text data from a URL into a Map.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes an HTTP connection with URL whitelisting, authentication, and SSL relaxations.

methods.name: expandMapArrays
methods.description: Recursively expands array structures within a Map for easier template access.
